name: php
template:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

$__conflate_state_path = $argv[1] ?? '';
$__conflate_reserved = [
    'argv', 'argc', 'GLOBALS', '_SERVER', '_GET', '_POST', '_FILES',
    '_COOKIE', '_SESSION', '_REQUEST', '_ENV',
];
if ($__conflate_state_path === '') {
    fwrite(STDERR, "Conflate PHP bridge requires a state path\n");
    exit(2);
}
$__conflate_json = file_get_contents($__conflate_state_path);
if ($__conflate_json === false) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "Conflate PHP bridge could not read the state file\n");
    exit(2);
}
try {
    $__conflate_state = json_decode($__conflate_json, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
} catch (JsonException $__conflate_error) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "Conflate PHP bridge received invalid JSON: " . $__conflate_error->getMessage() . "\n");
    exit(2);
}
if (!is_array($__conflate_state)) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "Conflate PHP bridge state must be an object\n");
    exit(2);
}
foreach ($__conflate_state as $__conflate_name => $__conflate_value) {
    if (!is_string($__conflate_name) || preg_match('/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/', $__conflate_name) !== 1 || str_starts_with($__conflate_name, '__conflate_') || in_array($__conflate_name, $__conflate_reserved, true)) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "Conflate PHP bridge received a reserved or invalid variable name\n");
        exit(2);
    }
    ${$__conflate_name} = $__conflate_value;
}

{source}

function __conflate_is_portable(mixed $value): bool
{
    if ($value === null || is_bool($value) || is_int($value) || is_string($value)) {
        return true;
    }
    if (is_float($value)) {
        return is_finite($value);
    }
    if (!is_array($value)) {
        return false;
    }
    foreach ($value as $__conflate_item) {
        if (!__conflate_is_portable($__conflate_item)) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

$__conflate_exports = [];
foreach (get_defined_vars() as $__conflate_name => $__conflate_value) {
    if (str_starts_with($__conflate_name, '__conflate_') || in_array($__conflate_name, $__conflate_reserved, true)) {
        continue;
    }
    if (!__conflate_is_portable($__conflate_value)) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "Conflate PHP bridge cannot export a nonportable value: " . $__conflate_name . "\n");
        exit(2);
    }
    $__conflate_exports[$__conflate_name] = $__conflate_value;
}
try {
    $__conflate_output = json_encode((object) $__conflate_exports, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
} catch (JsonException $__conflate_error) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "Conflate PHP bridge could not export a portable value: " . $__conflate_error->getMessage() . "\n");
    exit(2);
}
if (file_put_contents($__conflate_state_path, $__conflate_output) === false) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "Conflate PHP bridge could not write the state file\n");
    exit(2);
}
